name: Paolo Borchia - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion of the Agreement between the European Union and Iceland laying down the rules for participation of Iceland in the GOVSATCOM component of the Union Space Programme and in the Union Secure Connectivity Programme, and for access to GOVSATCOM services and to the governmental services of the Union Secure Connectivity Programme
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that Iceland should join two EU satellite programmes. One gives secure communications to governments and emergency services. The other is building a European satellite network for fast, secure internet, planned for 2027. Iceland will help pay, based on its economy, including for costs since 2021. Iceland gets no say in running the programmes, and the EU keeps ownership of the infrastructure. The agreement costs the EU budget nothing; Iceland's payments bring money in.

- Iceland joins the EU's secure satellite programmes and pays its share.
- Iceland's government users and satellite facilities are affected; the EU keeps control.
- The EU and Iceland can now formally conclude the agreement.
